newsitem.title: UK: BBEA H2 improves, no offer from Britannia.
newsitem.headline: BBEA H2 improves, no offer from Britannia.

text.p: British Building and Engineering Appliances Plc (BBEA) said it expected half year results to December 31, 1996 to show "a substantially improved position" on a year ago, when it had a pretax loss of 1.3 million stg.

The company, which supplies products and services to the building industry, added in a statement that it had not received any offer from Britannia Group Plc, a property developer which has built up an 11.8 percent stake.
Britannia said earlier this month in a statement that it considered BBEA "an attractive investment" and was seeking talks with the company.

BBEA said on Monday that it had met directors from Britannia once, on January 13, but that it "received no offer at that meeting or subsequently from Britannia and there are no discussions currently taking place".
BBEA added that "there is no obvious fit with the trading activities of the Britannia Group and BBEA would consider any merger of the two businesses to be a retrograde step".
